decisions.reason: Although only moderately visible, this express-delivery offer is close to the core business and supports the firm's public promise of fast response, so management is likely to persist and attribute any weak uptake to gradual market adoption.

The 72-hour program reinforces the same speed-and-service positioning, and after maintaining it on the website for two years management would be inclined to justify its operational investment by continuing it.
This express program had its own page in both years, showing stronger public commitment and clear fit with the firm's service-led strategy, which makes continued support very likely.

The online ordering and digital services platform likely required meaningful development effort and is central to the firm's stated move toward deeper advisory and service support, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
Its promotion from a website mention to a dedicated page in 2024 signals rising investment and commitment in a core safety-compliance product area, making management likely to keep backing it.
